name: Sal Celtica - Deja de usar sal común V3
master_prompt: Create ONE vertical 9:16 Spanish short-form UGC clip with native spoken audio for Sal Celtica. Each clip is one leaf scene only: one location, one camera setup, one visual idea, one exact spoken line. Tone: urgent, controversial, native TikTok, fast-paced, realistic kitchen UGC, not polished advertising. Character and voice continuity are mandatory across the whole video: preserve the same on-camera person, same face, same age, same outfit continuity, and one consistent Mexican-market Spanish accent/speaking style. Do not switch to a different person, narrator, gender, accent, or voice. Hands-only macro/detail shots may omit the face, but must not introduce a new visible person or new voice. Keep claims framed as educational/marketing narrative, not medical advice. No miracle cures, no disease claims, no fake doctor language, no social UI, no captions baked into generated video.

No product packaging, no logos, no readable labels, no text overlays, no subtitles baked into the image.
